entries.land_location_as_stated: 25 miles NE of Palm Springs; in a rural desert area
entries.description: A 5-acre homestead farm in the desert northeast of Palm Springs run by a couple of two lesbian feminists who raise vegetables, livestock, and bees, and offer to share their skills with wimmin-oriented lesbians and girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'). num_residents is 2 ('We live simply...'). Farming focus from raising vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees. Workshops/education focus from 'enjoy sharing our skills'. Land state inferred from mailing address and reference to Palm Springs.

entries.description: A woman-owned commercial dairy, cheese plant, and homestead farm with six dwellings, seeking lesbians to lease commercial operations or buy shares in ecologically run commercial farming. Strictly substance-free.
entries.raw_text: KIDS-LL-EAT IVY FARM 1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614 (916)823-3009. A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture. I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
entries.notes: Land address matches contact street address ('1220 Georgetown Rd'). Type is Private/Individual Land as it is individually owned ('I welcome lesbians', 'woman owned'). Focus on Recovery/substance-free from 'NO DRUGS.'; Farming/self-sufficiency from dairy, cheeseplant, gardening, and homestead animals; Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'ecologically run... farming'. num_residents left blank because specific resident count is not stated.

entries.description: A 120-acre intentional community of pacifists and vegetarians practicing organic farming, permaculture, and communal child raising, with six residents (women and men) welcoming new members, children of both sexes, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: FOLLY FARM 9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347 (503)879-5649. We are pacifists, vegetarians, and we practice organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women and men living and working on the land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND. Introduced with editor's note: 'NOTE: The following is not a women's land group, but it does welcome lesbians as visitors or members.' Street address is the land. num_residents is 6 ('1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians' and 'women and men living and working on the land'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on collective structure and shared communal child raising and labor. Accepted groups include Gay men and Non-gay men because men are part of the living/working resident community. Focus on Environmentalism/eco-friendly and Farming/self-sufficiency from 'organic agriculture, permaculture'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage
entries.description: A 10-acre women's resort and campground with lake frontage, three housekeeping cabins, campsites, and outdoor recreational activities, owned by one lesbian with other lesbians assisting in events and management.
entries.raw_text: WILDERNESS WAY Box 176, Wascott, WI 54890. (715)466-2635. Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing. Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active in planning special events and sharing management tasks. We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children, cats and dogs.
entries.notes: Appears under editor note: 'NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups, but we included them for your information.' Coded as a row per codebook specific instruction for Wilderness Way. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a campground and rental housekeeping units for guests. Land state is WI from mailing address. Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, and Boy children ('nonlesbian women, girl and boy children'). num_residents left blank because it does not state if the owner resides permanently.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino; woods
entries.description: A 2-acre guest retreat in the redwoods on the Mendocino coast offering a private cabin for up to three people for overnight rental, welcoming non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PEPPERLAND PO Box 464, Albion, CA 95410 (707)937-0020. We have a quiet, private cabin with detached, shared, bathroom facilities, $20 per night (up to 3 people). We are in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino. We welcome: nonlesbian women. We have: 2 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it is a guest cabin offered for rent per night ($20 per night). Land state is CA from mailing address and Mendocino Coast. num_residents is left blank as no resident count is specified.
